name: adapt-grow-journal
description: A lined notebook journal for learner-authored writing (reflections, notes) with no correct answer. Persists via suspend_data, not cmi.interactions. Not a question component.

extra.info: A ruled, paper-like textarea for reflective writing or note-taking. Auto-grows, saves to suspend_data, keeps the full text available to screen readers, and repaints with the active GROW theme.
